description_en: Creates multicast sources to implement one-to-many multicast communication
description_zh: 为了实现一对多的组播通信，调用RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources接口创建组播源
name: RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multicast domain to which the multicast source belongs
parameters.name: transit_router_multicast_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the multicast group to which the multicast source belongs. Valid values: 224.0.1.0 to 239.255.255.254.
<notice>224.0.0.0 to 224.0.0.127 are system reserved IP addresses and cannot be used as multicast group IP addresses.></notice>
If the multicast group that you specify does not exist in the current multicast domain, the system automatically creates a multicast group
parameters.help_zh:
组播源所属的组播组的IP地址。取值范围：224.0.1.0~239.255.255.254。
<notice>224.0.0.0～224.0.0.127为系统保留地址，不支持作为组播组IP地址。></notice>
如果当前组播域下不存在您指定的组播组，系统将自动为您创建新的组播组
parameters.name: group_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The list of network interface controller (NIC) IDs of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
parameters.name: network_interface_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the multicast source is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建组播源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建组播源
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC-connected instance to which the network interface controller (NIC) of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) belongs.

If the ENI belongs to the same Alibaba Cloud account as the account that you use to logon, you do not need to set this parameter.
If the ENI belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account from the account that you use to logon, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡所属的VPC实例ID。

如果弹性网卡所属阿里云账号和您当前登录的阿里云账号为相同账号，本参数可不填。
如果弹性网卡所属阿里云账号和您当前登录的阿里云账号为不同账号，本参数必填
parameters.name: vpc_id
